hypothesis: With ONLY EIGHT causal interventions (not thousands), will a tokenless native 8-cell action-conditioned model use archived original observations to repair its under-specified 4-feature linear substrate after a genuine contradiction, grow to eight interaction features, and transfer better than action-matched NO-REPLAY and matched-budget passive controls? Independently implemented conventional adaptive+fully specified 8-feature GF2 controls receive identical active actions, information and architectural priors; tie is not unique native intelligence.

source.class: Original in-house deterministic synthetic development, NOT independent science or externally qualified first-use
source.original_protocol: Each episode has exactly TWO genuine source actions. Public neutral action code0 causes 8-bit x_next=ROTL8(x,r) and reveals r from before/after when rotations distinguishable. The next action code1..16 selects controllable B=code-1 in range 0..15, causing x_next=ROTL8(x,r) XOR f(B); this produces real publicly observed 8-bit changed bits. Learners predict before step, observe only previous actual public source transitions afterward. Every arm acts on its OWN separately initialized identical source environment when action differs; at held, all arms get the SAME original action sequence B=0..15.
source.private_rotation: r=1+SHA256('ST9-r|'+law_id)[0]%3. Initial public x0 from smallest nonce0..255 SHA256('ST9-x|'+seed+'|'+trial+'|'+nonce)[0] with three distinct rotations. Public law/seed/trial/nonce never model inputs.
source.private_rule: Shared same-rule unknown 8-output GF(2) map over 8 public monomials of four action-input B bits: B0,B1,B2,B3,B0B1,B1B2,B2B3,B3B0. Output j/feature k true coefficient bit =SHA256('ST9-rule|'+j+'|'+k)[0]&1, evaluator-private; no correct rule menu to model.
source.private_new_rule_negative: For negative evaluator-only laws [43,47], substitute coefficient SHA256('ST9-alt|'+j+'|'+k)[0]&1 and add new cubic term B0B1B2 to output bit0, no extra mechanism selector signal; zero learner training on negative.
source.public_actor_active_policy: A hand-designed deterministic rank-increase greedy selection over the full eight admitted interaction feature vectors of candidates B in1..15, choose lowest B whose vector is independent of all previously selected public intervention feature vectors. It uses only public B history and a disclosed fixed feature family. No feedback-driven optimal experimental design or learned exploration claim; candidate, action-matched native ablations and independent active conventional share the SAME eight actions.

source_only_gate.qualification: TRAIN actor scopes ONLY. Eight real two-action episodes for each of active, passive-repeat, passive-dispersed arms under matched source law/seed/trial. Require authentic public neutral rotation recovery, actual public XOR outcomes, source-private 8x8 true coefficient map with >=8 nonzero second-order coefficients across rows, active actual B features rank8, passive repeat rank4 and dispersed rank6, all 8 original active action outcomes have rank8 consistent with admitted 8-feature source, at least one observed contradiction against 4-feature linear GF2 on active training source, exactly 16 per-arm real actions, three source action receipts dual-OS byte exact; held/negative/interference untouched. NO MODEL instantiated.
source_only_gate.failure: SOURCE_NONIDENTIFIABLE_OR_NO_LINEAR_CONTRADICTION_DEV_NO_GO. Freeze source and seed/action choices; do not modify after stage0 read.

candidate.architecture: Tokenless 8-cell native GF2 causal register initially four linear action features. After each real intervention, recover real output from public afteraction using observed neutral rotation. Maintain <=8 public experience (B,observed f(B)) pairs. On first genuinely inconsistent four-feature observation (feature vector in observed span but output disagrees), emit one bounded representation-repair event: expand to 8-feature quadratic interaction basis and replay previously stored public observations into new integer GF2 rows. Does NOT receive hidden coefficients, correct rule index, source law or any future label.
candidate.memory: At most eight GF2 rows of 8 feature and 8 output bits (16 bits each), public replay cache at most eight 4-bit B plus 8-bit output (<=2 bytes/entry), and bounded counter/snapshot. All arms have at most same 8 causal inputs, full and conventional active share same upper quadratic prior. Native exact cold JSON/byte check.
candidate.probe_policy: Frozen independent same public-rank-greedy actor as active independent conventional; not allowed to imply model autonomously invented policy.
candidate.training: Only eight training interventions per learner arm; NO additional fit or previously trained ST8 prior, all learned coefficients arise from original eight source actions.

frozen_metrics.primary: Cold unseen held law [29,31,37,41], 4 seeds each, exhaustive 16 possible B intervention values per law/seed. Exactly 256 real two-action episodes (512 genuine source steps) per trained arm, all learners predict before held probe source.step and train=False. Pooled eight-bit Brier <=0.02 candidate, <=0.04 each held law.
frozen_metrics.ablation: Candidate held Brier >=0.06 lower (absolute) than action-matched no-replay AND independent blind-dispersed strongest passive full model; >=0.10 lower than no-growth, erased, passive repeat. Every control fully trained for its only eight genuine interventions. Independently coded full and adaptive active conventional candidate noninferior within 0.01, ties reported no unique architecture.
frozen_metrics.mechanism: Native actual trigger count exactly1, actual observed linear contradiction >=1, 8/8 postrepair GF2 rank, replay of >=2 pre-growth public consequences, zero postgrowth cubic/quad contradictions, no future source leakage.
frozen_metrics.negative: Different-rule held mechanism frozen law[43,47] each full 16 action query values, zero fitting, require new-rule Brier >=0.10; report exact failures and don't call this general transfer.
frozen_metrics.retention: Cold recall TRAIN law3 at public probe B0..15 before and after eight same-rule interference actions (16 real steps), train=False during recall. >=95% measured chance-adjusted gain retained and <=0.02 absolute degradation; no distinct-world memory claim.
frozen_metrics.portability: One Linux-trained exact common artifact per all eight arm models; held+negative+recall source action hashes, model integer cold-state hashes, and Brier exactly cross OS. All original source action counts preserved, no opened held at model-training stage.
frozen_metrics.efficiency: Measure source+actor+learner training/evaluation and checkpoint wall time plus CPU/shared RSS. Entire common-process cost ratio candidate <=1.5x fastest fully trained ACTIVE conventional full/adaptive, both OS, and memory receipts. Isolated per-model RSS and independent full final regression remain unverified unless qualified.
frozen_metrics.classification: ALL prereg development predicates including meaningful no-replay gain and both OS cost -> BUDGETED_MEMORY_REPAIR_DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_SCIENTIFIC_PASS. ANY failure -> DEV_NO_GO; never tune ST9 after frozen held outcomes, never merge/promote based on in-house dev.
